en: A monochrome postcard-style image showing a wide, tree-lined boulevard with a central landscaped strip and tram tracks. A tram is visible traveling along the street, with pedestrians walking on sidewalks and people in a small park area in the foreground. Residential villas line the right side of the street, and there are lampposts and power poles along the road. At the bottom margin of the image there is printed caption text identifying the location.
